title: RBL Insignia Preferred Banking credit card

cardOverview.overviewText: An Insignia Preferred Banking card tailored for priority customers, offering exclusive banking-linked perks, lifestyle privileges, and milestone bonuses.

items.child: Get flat Rs 500 off on Movie tickets via BookMyShow every month.

benefitRows.name: Accor Plus
benefitRows.offer: Get Accor Plus membership on spending Rs 8 Lakh in previous anniversary year.
benefitRows.howToAvail: To avail your Accor Plus membership, check your email for the activation link and membership number. Visit the Accor Plus activation page, enter your membership number and registered email, and follow the prompts to activate. Download the Accor ALL app and log in to access your digital membership card and benefits.

benefitRows.name: BookMyShow
benefitRows.description: Get flat Rs 500 off on Movie tickets via BookMyShow every month.
benefitRows.howToAvail: To avail this offer, visit the BookMyShow website or app.|Select your movie, date, time, and seats.|Proceed to payment and find the offers/discounts section.|Select the applicable bank discount offer and enter your card details.|Complete the payment to get the Offer.
